tenderSchedule.title: Supply of Rubber Hand gloves to CESC
tenderSchedule.description: Supply of Rubber Hand gloves 15 kV, SEAMLESS Confirming to ISS for electrical purpose as per IS 13774- 2021 to CESC.
tenderSchedule.locationName: CESCOM Superintending Engineer Procurement Corporate Office Mysuru

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: b)The bidder should have an experience of 3 years in manufacturing/ supply of any one tendered materials.Document to be uploaded: Bidder shall upload original/notarized copies of the Purchase Order (PO) and corresponding Supply Certificates issued from KPTCL/ESCOMs/Govt. utilities of State/Electricity boards in India or Central Government undertakings by official not below the rank of Executive Engineer.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Purchase Order (PO) and corresponding Supply Certificates

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: c)The bidder should have supplied an average quantity of at least 80% of the tendered material in any one of the last two financial years (2024-25 & 2025-26) to the ESCOM/KPTCL/Govt. Utilities for the works of ESCOMs/Govt. utilities. Document to be uploaded: Original/notarised copies of Purchase order and corresponding Supply Certificates and performance certificate issued from KPTCL/ESCOMs/Govt. utilities of State/Electricity boards in India or Central Government undertakings by official not below the rank of Executive Engineer.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Purchase order and corresponding Supply Certificates and performance certificate

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: d)The bidder shall have the capacity to supply at least 25% quantity of the tendered material per month.Document to be uploaded: Self-Declaration in this regard.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Self declaration as per the criterion

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: i.The bidder shall have an average annual financial turnover 50% of the amount put to tender during the last two preceding financial years (put together) 2023-24 & 2024-25. (However, the average annual financial turnover will be 40% for Micro and Small Enterprises during the last two preceding financial years i.e., 2023-24 & 2024-25).Document to be uploaded: Audited Balance Sheet and Profit & Loss Statement of the last two preceding financial years.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: ii. The Liquid Assets as on or after the date of notification, before submission of the Bid, consisting of Cash at Bank plusTerm Deposits plus availability of fund based credit/OD facility in any Nationalized/scheduled Bank shall not be lesser than 25% of the amount put to tender.Document to be uploaded- The Cash at Bank & Bank deposits shall be supported by certificate issued by Chartered Accountant and Solvency/ availability of fund based credit/OD facility shall be supported by a certificate issued by any Nationalized/scheduled Bank with whom the bidder has banking facilities.

a)The Bidder should be Manufacturer/ authorized Supplier of the tendered material. In case of manufacturer, MSME certificate or any other relevant document confirming that the bidder is manufacturer shall be uploaded. In case of authorized supplier, an authorization letter from the manufacturer shall be uploaded.
tenderTechnicalCriterionList.criterionTypeOthersValue: The Bidder should be Manufacturer/ authorized Supplier

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Valid certificate as per criterion

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: e)The bidder must furnish One sample of tendered material confirming to tender technical specification before opening of the Technical bid date. If the sample is not as per tender specification, the offer of such bidder will not be considered.Self-declaration to be uploaded for submission of the sample.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Self declaration as per the criterion

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: f)The bidder should not be neither black listed nor defaulted by any ESCOM/KPTCL/Govt. Utilities for default in supply of materials. Document to be uploaded: Self-Declaration in this regard.
tenderTechnicalCriterionList.criterionTypeOthersValue: The bidder should not be neither black listed nor defaulted

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Self declaration as per the criterion

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: g)The bidder shall furnish the type test certificates of the tendered items conducted by CPRI/NABL accredited laboratory Certificate shall be furnished and such test reports shall not be older than three years from the date of bid opening.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Type test certificates not older than three years from the date of bid opening
